description: Repeatable conversation set for streaming-preview quality runs. Same set across providers (claude, opencode, codex, model variants).

questions.prompt: Reply with exactly one short sentence: what is a PTY?
Explain in 10-15 sentences how terminal scrollback works. Prose only, no code, no lists.
Give me a markdown bullet list of 8 common HTTP status codes with a one-line meaning each.
Write a python function fizzbuzz(n) that returns a list of strings. Show only one code block, no explanation.
Now shorten that fizzbuzz to at most 5 lines and show the code block again.
Create a file streaming-probe.txt containing the line 'hello streaming' and then show its contents.
Summarize what you did this session in exactly 5 sentences, then add a 3-line code snippet that prints them.
